headline: Vitória SC are 15th, and still clear favourites
summary: Vitória SC are 15th in the Primeira Liga on 5 points, yet on Friday they host Marítimo as clear favourites. History helps: the last 4 meetings all went to Vitória. So does Marítimo's attack, which averages 0.48 expected goals a game — which is why over 2.5 goals is priced at only 48.2%. Against that, the club confirmed goalkeeper Castillo and defender Dias out for 6 weeks. Across 10 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Vitória are 59.5% to win, more than three times Marítimo's chance, and rated 0.87 goals better — down from 1.0.
read: Vitória SC host Marítimo as clear 59.5% favourites even though they sit 15th, because Marítimo create almost nothing — 0.48 xG a game — and have lost the last four meetings. The home price and the goals line have both been trimmed in recent days after Vitória confirmed goalkeeper Juan Castillo and defender Francisco Dias are out for up to six weeks.

facts.fact: Vitória SC are clear favourites at 59.5% to win — more than three times Marítimo's chance.
facts.meaning: The home side is expected to take the points on Friday night.

facts.fact: Vitória SC sit 15th of 18 in the Primeira Liga after eight rounds.
facts.meaning: A home side near the bottom of the table — the favouritism is a call on this fixture, not on their season.

facts.fact: Marítimo average just 0.48 xG per game this season.
facts.meaning: They create almost nothing, which is the main reason they are such clear underdogs away from home.

facts.fact: Vitória SC confirmed goalkeeper Juan Castillo and defender Francisco Dias are out for up to six weeks with sprains.
facts.meaning: Two defensive options gone for the visit of Marítimo, on a squad already near the bottom of the table.

facts.fact: A Vitória SC player with eight appearances this season is in doubt for the Marítimo match, according to Notícias ao Minuto.
facts.meaning: A second possible absentee alongside the two confirmed, thinning the home options further.

facts.fact: The market rates Vitória about 0.9 goals better than Marítimo, down from a full goal in recent days.
Over 2.5 goals is priced at 48.2% — the market leans to a low-scoring game.
facts.meaning: Under 2.5 is the more likely side of the main goals line.

facts.fact: Vitória have won the last four meetings between the clubs, each by a single goal.
facts.meaning: A tight but one-sided history — Vitória keep winning these by the odd goal.

sources.fact: Vitória SC confirmed that goalkeeper Juan Castillo and defender Francisco Dias have suffered sprains and will be out for up to six weeks.
Vitória SC do not count on goalkeeper Juan Castillo and defender Francisco Dias for the upcoming matches.
A Vitória SC player with eight appearances this season is in doubt for the reception to Marítimo, according to Notícias ao Minuto.
Vitória SC beat fifth-tier Lamelas 1-0 to advance to the fourth round of the Taça de Portugal.
The match against Marítimo opens the ninth round of the I Liga and kicks off at 20:45 on Friday.
Vitória SC are offering companion tickets for the Marítimo match at 10 euros, up to two per member card.
Marítimo are involved in the ninth-round I Liga fixture against Vitória SC, with Diogo Rosa appointed as referee.
